raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Background

AUT-2636: scheduled [weekly run 40279403467](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/actions/runs/40279403467), attempt 1, failed in the expert-parallel leg. verl rejected `linear='FP8'`; its reported supported schemes include `FP8_BLOCK`.

## What changed

- Use `ROLLOUT_QUANTIZATION=fp8_block` in the Bridge-owned launcher.
- Add two isolated launcher tests for variant settings, failure propagation, and checkpoint cleanup.
- Preserve all three variants, topology, data, and timeout settings. No MCore change.

## Details

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[Weekly Bridge launcher] --> B[fp8_block selector]
  B --> C[verl quantization configuration]
  T[Isolated launcher tests] --> A
```
The unquantized variant completed in the failed run. The quantized variant failed before the later LoRA variant could run. Tests stub the external commands; they do not execute verl or prove training recovery.

## Tested

- `uv run python -m pytest -q tests/unit_tests/scripts/test_verl_ci.py`: 2 passed.
- `uv run mypy --strict tests/unit_tests/scripts/test_verl_ci.py`: passed.
- Repository pre-commit all-files hooks, Bash syntax, and all four lint-check shell scripts: passed.
- Revalidated against upstream base `25cdf971`; authoring head unchanged.

Required GitHub CI and review are pending. Local verl E2E execution is unavailable by policy. A later trusted scheduled run must pass the quantized and LoRA variants before E2E recovery is confirmed.

@@ -71,7 +71,7 @@ ray stop --force
 env "${common_env[@]}" \
     COMMON_EP=4 \

-    ROLLOUT_QUANTIZATION=fp8 \
+    ROLLOUT_QUANTIZATION=fp8_block \
     bash "${TRAINER_SCRIPT}"

+
+"""Check the Bridge-owned verl launcher without installing or running verl."""
+
+import os
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+SCRIPT = ROOT / ".github/workflows/verl_ci/run_megatron_moe_expert_parallel.sh"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("fail_quantized", [False, True])
+def test_expert_parallel_variants(tmp_path: Path, fail_quantized: bool) -> None:
+    bin_dir = tmp_path / "bin"
+    bin_dir.mkdir()
+    for command in ("pip3", "python3", "ray"):
+        stub = bin_dir / command
+        stub.write_text("#!/bin/bash\nexit 0\n")
+        stub.chmod(0o755)
+
+    # Intercept only the trainer invocation. Run the launcher itself with /bin/bash.
+    trainer = bin_dir / "bash"
+    trainer.write_text(
+        "#!/bin/bash\n"
+        'test "$1" = tests/special_e2e/run_ppo_trainer_megatron.sh || exit 99\n'
+        "mkdir -p checkpoints\n"
+        'printf "%s\\n" "$COMMON_PP,$COMMON_TP,$COMMON_ETP,$COMMON_EP,$INFER_TP,'
+        "${ROLLOUT_QUANTIZATION:-null},${LORA_RANK:-0},${CRITIC_LORA_RANK:-0},"
+        '${LORA_MERGE:-False}" >> "$CALL_LOG"\n'
+        'if [[ "$FAIL_QUANTIZED" = 1 && "${ROLLOUT_QUANTIZATION:-null}" != null ]]; then\n'
+        "    exit 23\n"
+        "fi\n"
+    )
+    trainer.chmod(0o755)
+    call_log = tmp_path / "calls"
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["/bin/bash", str(SCRIPT)],
+        cwd=tmp_path,
+        env={
+            "PATH": f"{bin_dir}:{os.defpath}",
+            "HOME": str(tmp_path),
+            "CALL_LOG": str(call_log),
+            "FAIL_QUANTIZED": str(int(fail_quantized)),
+        },
+        capture_output=True,
+        text=True,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+
+    assert result.returncode == (23 if fail_quantized else 0), result.stderr
+    expected = [
+        "2,4,1,4,8,null,0,0,False",
+        "2,4,1,4,2,fp8_block,0,0,False",
+        "2,4,1,2,8,null,8,8,True",
+    ]
+    if fail_quantized:
+        expected = expected[:2]
+    assert call_log.read_text().splitlines() == expected
+    assert not (tmp_path / "checkpoints").exists()
